description: This file defines the IHasher interface in the Orleans.Storage namespace, outlining methods for hashing operations used in Orleans Storage, including a description property and a Hash method that takes byte array data.

classes.name: IHasher
classes.description: An interface for hashing operations used in Orleans Storage, requiring a description string and a method to compute a hash from byte array data.
